title: Level 12 — Bash: Loops & Logic
subtitle: for, while, if, test and $( ) — turning commands into scripts
description: One command does one thing. Bash's control flow does it a hundred times, or only when it should. Learn to repeat work with `for` and `while`, make decisions with `if` and `test` ([ ]), and glue commands together with command substitution `$( )`.
